body:
<!-- pr-reviewer: 69a9825257c550d44e48337248670677a3ddea7b -->
**Verdict: Needs changes before merge.** One item: drop the `RELEASE_NOTES.md` edit. The code is good.

## What looks good
- The disabled state uses `browser_files::refusal`. This is the same table that command dispatch uses. The menu and the dispatch cannot disagree.
- Native builds are not changed. `state.browser_build` is `cfg!(target_arch = "wasm32")` (`crates/ui/src/state.rs:1966`). On native, `why` is always `None`, so `live` keeps its old value.
- Both new tests run the case `browser = false` and assert that the rows are enabled (`browser_file_menus.rs:19`, `:46`). Native behaviour is pinned.
- The tests also pin the reason text (tooltip) and that a click on a disabled row does nothing.
- No `unwrap`/`expect`/`panic`. No snapshot PNG. No dependency, `build.rs`, `.github/` or `scripts/` change. Files are under 400 lines. `Changelog:` and `Fixes #1431` are present. The decision file is present.

## Results merged with main (4f4edcf; no conflicts)
Built locally (no runner access: the runners API gave a 403).

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-ui --lib` (CWD `crates/ui`) | 776 passed, 0 failed, 5 ignored |
| `browser_theme_browse_is_disabled_with_a_reason` | pass |
| `browser_fixture_file_rows_are_disabled_with_reasons` | pass |
| `theme_door` tests (5) | pass |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-ui --all-targets -- -D warnings` | pass |
| `cargo check --target wasm32-unknown-unknown` | wasm not built: the check failed in third-party crates (`slab`, `smallvec` and others) in this environment, not in camcraft code |

## Requested before merge
1. **Drop the `RELEASE_NOTES.md` change.**
   - `RELEASE_NOTES.md` on main is the file of the released v0.19.0 (tag exists). The edit changes the notes of a version that is already published, and its new text says "since then".
   - AGENTS.md "Changelog" and "A cut goes PR review": notes are written on the release branch at the cut, not on an issue branch.
   - The stale lines are also in `release/v0.20.0` (`RELEASE_NOTES.md:327` and `:365` there). This edit does not fix that file. The fix for the 0.20.0 notes belongs on that branch, by the cut session.
   - The `Changelog:` line in the PR body already carries the row text for the cut.
   - Fix: `git checkout upstream/main -- RELEASE_NOTES.md`. Then update the decision file at `docs/decisions/1431-browser-menu-refusals.md`: remove the sentence "Correct the stale release-note claim ..." and the same item in the PR body.

## Questions / notes (not blocking)
- Overlap with #1639: a trial merge of this head with #1639's head has no conflicts. The new tests are in a separate child module, and the only change in `structural.rs` is the 3 appended lines.
- `structural.rs` is 588 lines (over the guideline before this PR; grows by 3 only).
- The wasm build and a browser session were not run (by the author or by me). The change is behind a runtime flag, so the risk is low, but the real browser look is not checked.
- The Codex pre-review said CLEAN. I agree on the code. It did not examine the release-notes edit.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
